articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596210 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Abuja Level: Consultancy Location: Nigeria Categories: Nutrition Consultancy to provide technical support to advance large-scale food fortification (LSFF) and iodine nutrition agenda in West and Central Africa (WCAR ) Office based in Abuja, Nigeria (with travel across West Africa / Member States) UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. UNICEF seeks an experienced consultant to deliver a defined package of high-level technical, policy and coordination outputs in support of the relevant Regional Economic Communities and Member States to accelerate progress on large-scale food fortification (LSFF), including universal salt iodization (USI), and related nutrition policy priorities across the West and Central Africa Region (WCAR). The consultant will prepare technical products and draft frameworks to support the RECs efforts related to strengthening institutional capacity, advancing regional standards and regulatory frameworks, preparing operational recommendations in selected Member States, and preparing consultation outputs and technical documentation supporting regional LSFF commitments, including USI. The consultant will also contribute to the broader food systems transformation agenda, including the First Foods Africa initiative, and deliver technical outputs supporting policy reform, standards harmonization, technical specifications for strengthening of ECOQMARK and monitoring systems, and draft country-specific implementation roadmaps for institutional review of LSFF programmes, including USI. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: ToRTMC0007054.pdf Education: Masters in Nutrition, Partnerships, Advocacy, Development, Communications, Economics Work Experience: 10-15 years of progressively responsible professional experience in public nutrition, food systems, public health or related development programming, with substantial experience in LSFF, USI or micronutrient deficiency prevention. Demonstrated experience supporting regional or multi-country programmes in Africa, preferably within WCAR. Proven track record of working with inter-governmental bodies such as ECOWAS, African Union, Regional Economic Communities, governments, UN agencies, development partners, academia and/or private sector stakeholders. Strong experience in policy reform, standards development, regulatory frameworks, trade facilitation or programme implementation in low- and middle-income countries. Experience in planning and facilitating high-level consultations, ministerial meetings, technical working groups and multi-stakeholder platforms. Strong communication, negotiation, diplomacy and stakeholder management skills. Skills: Strong technical knowledge of LSFF, USI, food systems, food standards, quality assurance/control systems, premix supply systems, regulatory monitoring and compliance mechanisms. Good understanding of regional trade systems, including certification and cross-border regulatory frameworks Language Requirements: Fluency in written and oral French and English is required. Fluency or working knowledge of Portuguese is desirable. Previous experience working with RECs or any other African Regional Economic Communities. Experience in West African francophone countries. UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. UNICEF is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. Qualified candidates are invited to submit the following documents via the online recruitment portal, TMS (Talent Management System): An up-to-date TMS profile and curriculum vitae (CV) A separate financial proposal (only acceptable in the format of the linked template) Financial proposal TMC0007054.docx If the TOR or financial proposal documents are not visible on certain recruitment platforms, please visit our official page Vacancies | UNICEF Careers . UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants’ bank account information. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 09 Oct 2026 W. Central Africa Standard Time Deadline: 25 Oct 2026 W. Central Africa Standard Time

CONDITIONS DE PARTICIPATION :
Le Concours est ouvert aux Candidats Civils et Militaires justifiant avoir validé le
cursus normal du résidanat des centres hospitaliers siège de faculté de médecine et de
pharmacie (ou justifiant avoir validé dans les centres hospitaliers universitaires étrangers un2
cursus de formation assimilé au cursus cité ci-dessus) dont la durée est de quatre ans au moins
pour les spécialités médicales ou pharmaceutiques et de cinq ans au moins pour les spécialités
chirurgicales ou la spécialité de médecine interne.
DOSSIER DE CANDIDATURE
 Une demande de candidature manuscrite adressée au Doyen de la Faculté, sous couvert de
la voix hiérarchique, indiquant le Nom, Prénom, Téléphone, E-mail et Adresse du Candidat et
la Spécialité pour laquelle il désire concourir ainsi que le lieu d’affectation actuelle ;
 Autorisation du Ministère de la Santé ;
 Quatre (04) attestations confirmant la validation du cursus normal du résidanat dans la
spécialité objet de concours ;
 Quatre (04) extraits d'acte de naissance ;
 Quatre (04) photocopies de la Carte d’Identité Nationale certifiées conformes ;
 Quatre (04) photocopies certifiées conforme du Diplôme du Doctorat ;
 Tous les documents officiels permettant d'apprécier les titres et services du candidat, de
même que les attestations concernant les activités pédagogiques ;
 Une épreuve de titres et travaux scientifiques (format numérique – PDF – Clé USB), avec
justification des publications, communications et validation des productions audiovisuelles.
N B : Les dossiers de candidature doivent être déposés au Service des Affaires Administratives de
la Faculté avant le 28 Octobre 2026.
Adresse : Avenue Mohammed Belarbi EL ALAOUI – BP 6203 Rabat – Instituts - Tél : 05 37 77 35 60 Fax : 05 37 77 37 01
Web : fmp.um5.ac.ma email : fmp@um5.ac.ma

Novembre 2026 dans les spécialités suivantes :

CONDITIONS DE PARTICIPATION :
Le Concours est ouvert aux Candidats Civils et Militaires justifiant avoir validé le
cursus normal du résidanat des centres hospitaliers siège de faculté de médecine et de
pharmacie (ou justifiant avoir validé dans les centres hospitaliers universitaires étrangers un2
cursus de formation assimilé au cursus cité ci-dessus) dont la durée est de quatre ans au moins
pour les spécialités médicales ou pharmaceutiques et de cinq ans au moins pour les spécialités
chirurgicales ou la spécialité de médecine interne.
DOSSIER DE CANDIDATURE
 Une demande de candidature manuscrite adressée au Doyen de la Faculté, sous couvert de
la voix hiérarchique, indiquant le Nom, Prénom, Téléphone, E-mail et Adresse du Candidat et
la Spécialité pour laquelle il désire concourir ainsi que le lieu d’affectation actuelle ;
 Autorisation du Ministère de la Santé ;
 Quatre (04) attestations confirmant la validation du cursus normal du résidanat dans la
spécialité objet de concours ;
 Quatre (04) extraits d'acte de naissance ;
 Quatre (04) photocopies de la Carte d’Identité Nationale certifiées conformes ;
 Quatre (04) photocopies certifiées conforme du Diplôme du Doctorat ;
 Tous les documents officiels permettant d'apprécier les titres et services du candidat, de
même que les attestations concernant les activités pédagogiques ;
 Une épreuve de titres et travaux scientifiques (format numérique – PDF – Clé USB), avec
justification des publications, communications et validation des productions audiovisuelles.
N B : Les dossiers de candidature doivent être déposés au Service des Affaires Administratives de
la Faculté avant le 28 Octobre 2026.
Adresse : Avenue Mohammed Belarbi EL ALAOUI – BP 6203 Rabat – Instituts - Tél : 05 37 77 35 60 Fax : 05 37 77 37 01
Web : fmp.um5.ac.ma email : fmp@um5.ac.ma

articles.seo_title: مباراة توظيف أساتذة محاضرين (مدنيين وعسكريين) بجامعة محمد الخامس
articles.seo_description: تنظم جامعة محمد الخامس بالرباط مباراة لتوظيف 34 أستاذا محاضرا مدنيا وعسكريا، لآخر أجل لإيداع الترشيحات هو 27 أكتوبر 2026.
articles.final_html:
تنظم جامعة محمد الخامس بالرباط، ممثلة في كلية الطب والصيدلة، مباراة لتوظيف أساتذة محاضرين (مدنيين وعسكريين) برسم دورة 17 نونبر 2026. تفتح هذه المباراة لشغل 34 منصباً، منها 31 منصباً للمدنيين و3 مناصب للعسكريين.

التخصصات والمناصب

المناصب المدنية (31 منصباً)

تتوزع المناصب المدنية على التخصصات التالية:

  • العلوم الأساسية: تخصصات بيولوجية
    • التشريح الباثولوجي: 1 منصب
  • العلوم السريرية:
    • تخصصات الطب والتخصصات الطبية:
      • الإنعاش والتخدير: 1 منصب
      • طب النفس للأطفال: 3 مناصب
      • طب الأطفال: 1 منصب
      • الطب النووي: 1 منصب
      • الراديولوجيا: 4 مناصب
      • الطب الفيزيائي وإعادة التأهيل الوظيفي: 1 منصب
      • الروماتيزم: 1 منصب
      • أمراض الكلى: 2 مناصب
      • الإنعاش الطبي: 1 منصب
      • أمراض الدم السريرية: 2 مناصب
      • الطب الباطني: 1 منصب
    • التشريح والجراحات والتخصصات الجراحية:
      • جراحة الأوعية الدموية الطرفية: 1 منصب
      • طب الطوارئ والكوارث: 3 مناصب
      • جراحة الصدر: 1 منصب
      • طب الأنف والأذن والحنجرة: 1 منصب
      • جراحة العظام والمفاصل: 2 مناصب
      • جراحة الأطفال: 1 منصب
      • جراحة الأعصاب: 2 مناصب
      • الجراحة العامة: 1 منصب

المناصب العسكرية (3 مناصب)

تتوزع المناصب العسكرية على التخصصات التالية:

  • العلوم الأساسية: تخصصات بيولوجية
    • علم المناعة: 1 منصب
  • العلوم السريرية:
    • تخصصات الطب والتخصصات الطبية:
      • الروماتيزم: 1 منصب
    • التشريح والجراحات والتخصصات الجراحية:
      • الجراحة العامة: 1 منصب

شروط المشاركة

تفتح المباراة في وجه المترشحين المدنيين والعسكريين الذين يثبتون استيفاء المسار العادي للإقامة بالمراكز الاستشفائية الجامعية التابعة لكليات الطب والصيدلة (أو إثبات استيفاء مسار تكويني مماثل في مراكز استشفائية جامعية أجنبية) لمدة لا تقل عن أربع سنوات بالنسبة للتخصصات الطبية أو الصيدلية، وخمس سنوات على الأقل بالنسبة للتخصصات الجراحية أو تخصص الطب الباطني.

ملف الترشيح

يجب أن يتضمن ملف الترشيح الوثائق التالية:

  • طلب ترشيح مكتوب بخط اليد موجه إلى عميد الكلية، تحت إشراف التسلسل الإداري، مع ذكر الاسم الكامل ورقم الهاتف والبريد الإلكتروني وعنوان المترشح والتخصص المراد الترشح له ومكان التعيين الحالي.
  • ترخيص من وزارة الصحة.
  • أربع (04) شهادات تؤكد استيفاء المسار العادي للإقامة في التخصص المطلوب.
  • أربع (04) نسخ من عقد الازدياد.
  • أربع (04) نسخ مصادق عليها من البطاقة الوطنية للتعريف.
  • أربع (04) نسخ مصادق عليها من دبلوم الدكتوراه.
  • جميع الوثائق الرسمية التي تمكن من تقييم مؤهلات وخدمات المترشح، بالإضافة إلى الشهادات المتعلقة بالأنشطة البيداغوجية.
  • نسخة من الألقاب والأعمال العلمية (بصيغة رقمية – PDF – على مفتاح USB)، مع تبرير المنشورات والاتصالات وتصديق المنتجات السمعية البصرية.

طريقة الترشيح والآجال

يتعين على المترشحين إيداع ملفات ترشيحهم لدى مصلحة الشؤون الإدارية بكلية الطب والصيدلة التابعة لجامعة محمد الخامس بالرباط.

  • آخر أجل لإيداع الترشيحات: 27 أكتوبر 2026.
  • تاريخ إجراء المباراة: 17 نونبر 2026.

للإطلاع على تفاصيل المباراة والترشيح، يرجى زيارة المنصة الرسمية:

articles.job_description: Explore our current job opportunities Social & Behavior Change Officer (NO-2), TA(364 days), #00138677, Deir-ez-Zor - Syria, MENA Apply now Job no: JPR0004288 Contract type: Temporary Appointment Duty Station: Deir-ez-Zor Location: Syrian Arab Republic Categories: Social and Behavior Change UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to a Future The vision of Social and Behaviour Change (SBC) within the new UNICEF Syria Country Programme is to strengthen community systems and resilience by empowering communities, families, adolescents, and children to actively participate in shaping and restoring their own development outcomes. This includes enhancing the knowledge and capacity of both rights holders and duty bearers, promoting meaningful community participation in identifying challenges and co-creating solutions, increasing demand for and utilization of essential social services, addressing harmful social norms and negative coping mechanisms, and fostering positive changes in knowledge, attitudes, perceptions, and behaviours that contribute to improved well-being for children and their families in Syria. To advance this vision, SBC will work in close collaboration with all programmes and relevant partners to integrate behavioural and social insights into programme design, implementation, and monitoring. Through evidence-based approaches, SBC will support efforts to address behavioural, social, and normative barriers that affect children's access to services and outcomes, while ensuring alignment with national recovery and development priorities. The Country Programme will implement both sectoral and cross-sectoral SBC interventions through a twin-track approach that combines strengthening community engagement, participation, accountability, and local systems with the generation and use of behavioural and social data. This approach will support the identification of priority issues, inform adaptive programming, and contribute to sustainable improvements in service uptake, social cohesion, and outcomes for children and communities across Syria. How can you make a difference? Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Field Office, Deir-ez-Zor FO, and under the technical guidance of the Chief of SBC Section from the Country Office, and in close coordination with Sectoral and Cross-Sectoral Specialists and Officers, you will contribute to and be responsible for the design, management, monitoring, and evaluation of evidence-based, inclusive, and innovative SBC strategies in support of the country programme. As the Social & Behavior Change Officer, you will support the design, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of evidence-based Social and Behaviour Change (SBC) strategies that contribute to improved outcomes for children, adolescents, and communities in Syria. Working under the supervision of the Chief of Field Office and in close collaboration with programme sections, government counterparts, and implementing partners, you will promote the integration of behavioural and social insights into both development and humanitarian programming. You will contribute to strengthening community engagement, participation, accountability, and resilience through the use of research, evidence, and innovative approaches to address social and behavioural barriers affecting children’s well-being and access to services. Key accountabilities include Research, Data and Evidence Generation; Design and Implementation of SBC Strategies and Interventions; Advocacy, Partnership Building and Resource Mobilization; and Capacity Development and Knowledge Management . Through these functions, you will support UNICEF’s mandate to advance child rights and achieve sustainable, equitable results for children and families.If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: TOR SBC NOB (DEZ FO).pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have… Education: A university degree (Bachelor's or higher) in a social and behavioral science, including sociology, anthropology, communication studies/communication for development, psychology and/or or any other science specialization or related field is required. Work Experience: A minimum of two years of professional experience in one or more of the following areas is required: social development programme planning, communication for development or social and behaviour change, public advocacy or another related area. Key skills include SBC programming, community engagement, behavioural insights, research and analysis, stakeholder coordination, and monitoring and evaluation. Language Requirements: Fluency in English and Arabic is required. Language: Knowledge of another official UN language (Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) or a local language is an asset. Relevant experience in a UNICEF/ UN system agency or organization is considered an asset. Relevant experience in Deir-ez-Zor Governorate, particularly in development, fragile settings, and humanitarian contexts, is an asset. For every Child, you demonstrate... UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF competencies required for this post are… (1) Builds and maintains partnerships (2) Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness (3) Drive to achieve results for impact (4) Innovates and embraces change (5) Manages ambiguity and complexity (6) Thinks and acts strategically (7) Works collaboratively with others Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels. UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. CEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Issuance of a visa by the host country of the duty station is required for IP positions and will be facilitated by UNICEF. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates’ willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service. As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity. UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable candidates are encouraged to apply. Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason. UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants' bank account information. The conditions of a temporary assignment, including relocation entitlements, will depend on the status of the staff member's original appointment and may be limited in accordance with applicable UNICEF policies, procedures, and practices in force. Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities. Visa residence requirements: i.e. UNICEF shall not facilitate the issuance of a visa and working authorization for candidates under consideration for positions at the national officer and general service category. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596211 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Stockholm Level: Consultancy Location: Sweden Categories: Innovation Office of Innovation – Systems & Services – Insights & Evidence function – Stockholm, Sweden & Remote, with possible travel ************************************************************************************ UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. To provide hands-on, specialized expertise in data and systems integration, application and workflow development, automation and applied AI to the UNICEF Office of Innovation (OOI). The Consultant will play a critical role in advancing OOI’s Insights & Evidence function by designing and deploying data tools, analytics, knowledge systems, and intelligent workflows that help UNICEF better leverage data and knowledge for innovation. We are looking for Innovation Data and Product Consultant to join the Insights and Evidence team at UNICEF's Office of Innovation (OOI). You will help OOI better leverage data and knowledge to support innovation, by developing systems and applications and using innovative analytical methods, including AI and large language models, so that timely insights reach the colleagues and decision-makers who need them across UNICEF and, where relevant, the wider humanitarian and development community. The role covers the full cycle from problem exploration to deployment and adoption, including helping users build the know-how and confidence to use these tools and solutions effectively. You will work under the guidance of the Knowledge Management and Data Analytics Lead, in close collaboration with OOI's Systems & Services and Solutions sections and other UNICEF offices. The work combines strong technical execution with thoughtful product design grounded in systems thinking and Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles. The aim is to bring leading product and data/AI engineering practices from industry into the UNICEF context, while keeping solutions cost-effective, lean and appropriate for the contexts in which UNICEF works. We work in a build-test-learn way, moving quickly from ideas to minimum viable products and iterating based on real-world use. It will suit a versatile builder who enjoys moving between data, technology and product design to develop practical solutions to complex problems. Apply systems thinking and HCD methods to deeply understand user pain points and use cases for data, knowledge and AI solutions. Gather reliable evidence to test assumptions and articulate design decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Design and build data models, databases, pipelines and data entry workflows that connect different sources into a reliable base of information. Develop dashboards, applications and other data and knowledge products for OOI, UNICEF and partners, including solutions tailored to specific Country Offices and innovation teams. Build and automate workflows for capturing, processing, and using data and knowledge, including through AI. articles.job_description: Description de l'entreprise ALTEN Maroc , filiale du leader mondial du conseil en ingénierie et technologies, a été créée en 2008 et est aujourd’hui présente à Fès, Rabat, Tétouan et Casablanca. Aujourd’hui, l’entreprise compte plus de 2 200 collaborateurs et ambitionne de devenir un centre d’excellence avec 3 300 ALTENiens d’ici fin 2027. Elle s’est positionnée comme un acteur stratégique dans l’accompagnement du développement professionnel des ingénieurs. Notre mission : Répondre aux ambitions technologiques de nos clients — de grandes entreprises internationales — dans les secteurs de l’automobile, du ferroviaire, de la R&D et de l’IT, des télécommunications et des médias. Rejoindre ALTEN Maroc, c’est intégrer un écosystème d’excellence et bénéficier : D’un parcours de carrière personnalisé et évolutif, D’une politique ambitieuse de développement des compétences, D’un environnement de travail stimulant, collaboratif et porteur de sens. Description du poste Construire, maintenir et faire évoluer l’eBOM dans ENOVIA. Assurer l’interface entre les équipes conception et la fonction nomenclature. Traduire les données techniques en codifications LCDV et les intégrer dans ENOVIA. Animer les revues hebdomadaires avec les différentes équipes métiers (Carrosserie, Intérieur, Mécatronique, Châssis, SWX, PRS, Faisceaux Électriques). Accompagner et valider les demandes de modification de l’eBOM. Gérer la codification de la diversité produit et l’évolution de la composition produit. Participer aux arbitrages des commissions nomenclature. Construire et maintenir l’arbre DMU. Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et l’exhaustivité des données eBOM. Préparer les jalons d’officialisation du PDP (FOCUS 2/CAD 2 Release et FOCUS 3/Authentic Release). Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion de nomenclature et de données produit. Bonne maîtrise des langues française et anglais Savoir utiliser les différents logiciels bureautiques Capacité de rédaction des CR et esprit de synthèse Diplômé d’un Bac +5 , Génie industriel ou Génie Mécanique Informations supplémentaires

ai_input_package.full_article_text: Description de l'entreprise ALTEN Maroc , filiale du leader mondial du conseil en ingénierie et technologies, a été créée en 2008 et est aujourd’hui présente à Fès, Rabat, Tétouan et Casablanca. Aujourd’hui, l’entreprise compte plus de 2 200 collaborateurs et ambitionne de devenir un centre d’excellence avec 3 300 ALTENiens d’ici fin 2027. Elle s’est positionnée comme un acteur stratégique dans l’accompagnement du développement professionnel des ingénieurs. Notre mission : Répondre aux ambitions technologiques de nos clients — de grandes entreprises internationales — dans les secteurs de l’automobile, du ferroviaire, de la R&D et de l’IT, des télécommunications et des médias. Rejoindre ALTEN Maroc, c’est intégrer un écosystème d’excellence et bénéficier : D’un parcours de carrière personnalisé et évolutif, D’une politique ambitieuse de développement des compétences, D’un environnement de travail stimulant, collaboratif et porteur de sens. Description du poste Construire, maintenir et faire évoluer l’eBOM dans ENOVIA. Assurer l’interface entre les équipes conception et la fonction nomenclature. Traduire les données techniques en codifications LCDV et les intégrer dans ENOVIA. Animer les revues hebdomadaires avec les différentes équipes métiers (Carrosserie, Intérieur, Mécatronique, Châssis, SWX, PRS, Faisceaux Électriques). Accompagner et valider les demandes de modification de l’eBOM. Gérer la codification de la diversité produit et l’évolution de la composition produit. Préparer les jalons d’officialisation du PDP (FOCUS 2/CAD 2 Release et FOCUS 3/Authentic Release). Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion de nomenclature et de données produit. articles.seo_description: تعلن ALTEN المغرب، الرائدة في الاستشارات الهندسية، عن فتح باب الترشيح لتوظيف مهندس E-BOM PILOTE بمدينة تطوان.
articles.final_html:
تعلن شركة ALTEN المغرب، وهي فرع لشركة عالمية رائدة في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية والتكنولوجية، عن فرصة عمل لشغل منصب مهندس E-BOM PILOTE بمدينة تطوان.

مهام الوظيفة الرئيسية

  • بناء وصيانة وتطوير هيكل المنتج الإلكتروني (eBOM) في نظام ENOVIA.
  • تأمين التواصل بين فرق التصميم ووظيفة التسميات.
  • ترجمة البيانات التقنية إلى ترميزات LCDV ودمجها في ENOVIA.
  • تنشيط المراجعات الأسبوعية مع فرق العمل المختلفة (هيكل السيارة، التصميم الداخلي، الميكاترونيك، الهيكل، SWX، PRS، الحزم الكهربائية).
  • مرافقة والمصادقة على طلبات تعديل eBOM.
  • إدارة ترميز تنوع المنتجات وتطور تركيبة المنتج.
  • المشاركة في تحكيم لجان التسميات.
  • بناء وصيانة شجرة DMU.
  • ضمان جودة وتماسك وشمولية بيانات eBOM.
  • إعداد مراحل إضفاء الطابع الرسمي على خطة تطوير المنتج (PDP) (إصدار FOCUS 2/CAD 2 و FOCUS 3/Authentic).
  • المساهمة في التحسين المستمر لعمليات إدارة التسميات وبيانات المنتج.

المؤهلات المطلوبة

  • دبلوم بكالوريا +5 في الهندسة الصناعية أو الهندسة الميكانيكية.
  • إتقان جيد للغتين الفرنسية والإنجليزية.
  • القدرة على استخدام برامج المكتب المختلفة.
  • القدرة على صياغة محاضر الاجتماعات وامتلاك روح التلخيص.

تفاصيل الوظيفة

  • الموقع: تطوان
  • نوع العقد: دوام كامل

كيفية التقديم

يمكن للمرشحين المهتمين تقديم طلباتهم عبر المنصات الرسمية التالية:

  • منصة الترشيح الرسمية
  • رابط الإعلان الرسمي

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596213 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Valencia Level: Consultancy Location: Spain Categories: Information Communication Technology UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture., coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. Prepare, clean and structure the agreed test prompt set. Conduct extensive testing of agreed prompts across multiple LLM providers and configurations, and curate the most informative model responses for expert review. Run evaluations under different approved safety/content-filter configurations and document how these settings affect model behaviour. Capture model responses and relevant test metadata. Troubleshoot API, model, safety-filter or platform issues. Develop and maintain code to call commercial LLM APIs and, where required, deploy and interact with open-source models for evaluation. Conduct targeted reviews of state-of-the-art child-safety and AI-safety research to identify relevant prompts, failure modes and emerging risks. Organise outputs into a simple format for expert review. Capture review results in a structured, exportable format. Iterate the prototype based on expert feedback. Participate in communication with reviewers, collect feedback on both model behaviour and the review process, and refine the testing/review infrastructure accordingly. Support re-testing when experts identify new failure modes, ambiguities or edge cases. Help translate expert feedback into new or refined test cases. Maintain a clean, versioned prompt-response dataset. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. UNICEF is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles. articles.job_description: Description de l'entreprise Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques, avec plus de 27 000 collaborateurs dans 19 pays et un chiffre d’affaires de 2,4 milliards d’euros en 2024. Le Groupe accompagne entreprises et institutions dans leur transformation digitale, alliant performance, innovation et impact sociétal. Présent au Maroc depuis plus de 20 ans, Inetum Maroc joue un rôle stratégique avec plus de 800 collaborateurs, un centre de services partagés et un FabLab à Casablanca. Avec 50 millions d’euros de chiffre d’affaires en 2024, l'entité se positionne comme un acteur majeur du numérique au niveau local. S’appuyant sur ses trois lignes de métiers – Inetum Consulting, Inetum Technologies et Inetum Solutions – et des partenariats clés avec Microsoft, SAP et Sage, Inetum Maroc se distingue aussi par l’obtention du label Feel Good 2025, qui valorise son engagement pour le bien-être, l’inclusion et le développement des compétences. La culture d’entreprise s’ancre dans la Inetum Way, un socle de valeurs fondé sur la proximité, l’agilité, l’innovation et la responsabilité. Rejoindre Inetum, c’est vivre pleinement son impact digital dans un environnement stimulant, humain et durable. Description du poste En tant qu'Expert ToIP, vous serez le référent technique de l'écosystème voix et assurerez le pilotage des projets ainsi que le maintien en conditions opérationnelles des plateformes. ✅ Piloter les projets techniques de bout en bout : Coordination des équipes d'ingénierie Gestion des risques et dépendances Escalades fournisseurs et opérateurs Plans d'actions et amélioration continue Suivi de la qualité de service ✅ Conduire les évolutions techniques : Informations supplémentaires Nous recherchons un consultant disposant : ✔️ d'une forte expertise Microsoft Teams Voice ✔️ d'une excellente maîtrise des environnements SIP / VoIP / SBC ✔️ d'une expérience significative en Direct Routing ✔️ d'une culture réseau et sécurité solide ✔️ d'une expérience en pilotage de projets techniques ✔️ d'une expérience dans des environnements internationaux à forte criticité ✔️ d'une bonne connaissance des processus ITIL

articles.seo_description: تعلن Inetum عن وظيفة خبير ToIP / Teams Voice بدوام كامل في الدار البيضاء، للعمل على إدارة مشاريع الصوت والأنظمة الأساسية.
articles.final_html:
تعلن شركة Inetum، الرائدة الأوروبية في الخدمات الرقمية، عن فتح باب التوظيف لشغل منصب خبير ToIP / Teams Voice بالدار البيضاء.

مهام الوظيفة

  • قيادة المشاريع التقنية من البداية إلى النهاية: تنسيق فرق الهندسة، إدارة المخاطر والتبعيات، تصعيد المشكلات للموردين والمشغلين، وضع خطط العمل والتحسين المستمر، ومتابعة جودة الخدمة.
  • قيادة التطورات التقنية.

المؤهلات المطلوبة

  • خبرة قوية في Microsoft Teams Voice.
  • إتقان ممتاز لبيئات SIP / VoIP / SBC.
  • خبرة كبيرة في Direct Routing.
  • ثقافة شبكية وأمنية قوية.
  • خبرة في إدارة المشاريع التقنية.
  • خبرة في بيئات دولية ذات أهمية حرجة.
  • معرفة جيدة بعمليات ITIL.

طريقة الترشيح

على الراغبين في الترشح لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل تقديم طلباتهم عبر المنصة الرسمية.

  • منصة الترشيح الرسمية
  • تفاصيل الإعلان الرسمي

articles.facebook_post_text:
‏📍 إينتوم توظف خبيرًا في تقنية الصوت عبر بروتوكول الإنترنت وصوت فرق مايكروسوفت بالدار البيضاء.

‏💼 تعلن شركة إينتوم، الرائدة الأوروبية في الخدمات الرقمية، عن فتح باب الترشح لمنصب بدوام كامل.

‏تشمل المهام قيادة المشاريع التقنية من البداية إلى النهاية، تنسيق فرق الهندسة، إدارة المخاطر والتبعيات، ووضع خطط التحسين المستمر.

‏المؤهلات المطلوبة تتضمن خبرة قوية في صوت فرق مايكروسوفت، إتقان بيئات بروتوكولات سيب وفويب وإس بي سي، وخبرة كبيرة في التوجيه المباشر.

‏يتطلب المنصب أيضاً ثقافة شبكية وأمنية قوية، خبرة في إدارة المشاريع التقنية، وفي بيئات دولية حرجة، بالإضافة إلى معرفة جيدة بعمليات آيتيل.

‏👇 للاطلاع على تفاصيل المهام والشروط الكاملة للترشيح وطريقة التقديم، اطلع على أول تعليق.

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596214 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Ulan Bator Level: Consultancy Location: Mongolia Categories: Education UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. The purpose of this consultancy is to provide time-bound, specialized technical expertise, to support UNICEF Mongolia in advancing key priorities related to education-sector digital transformation. The assignment will focus on strengthening the strategic planning, implementation and monitoring of digital education initiatives; providing technical inputs for the development and application of innovative and inclusive digital learning approaches and solutions; and generating evidence and knowledge to inform programme planning and decision-making. The consultancy will contribute to UNICEF Mongolia’s ongoing cooperation with the Ministry of Education and other relevant partners by producing specific technical analyses, programme and policy inputs, implementation and monitoring products, knowledge products, and partnership and resource-mobilization materials. Particular attention will be given to strengthening equitable access to digital learning; supporting the effective and responsible integration of digital technologies and emerging innovations in education; and ensuring that digital education interventions respond to the needs of children in remote, rural, disadvantaged and underserved communities. The consultancy will also contribute to strengthening strategic partnerships for digital education, including engagement with Korean development cooperation partners and other international stakeholders, through the preparation of technical and programme inputs to support technical cooperation, resource mobilization, sustainability and the potential scale-up of UNICEF-supported initiatives. Through clearly defined and measurable deliverables to be completed within the consultancy period, the assignment will provide the specialized technical inputs required to consolidate selected ongoing digital education initiatives and inform their further development, sustainability and potential scale-up. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: International Digital Education Consultant.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have... Minimum requirements: ( Qualifications/Experience/ Knowledge/Expertise/Skills) Education: An advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in Education, Education Management, Education Policy, or a related field. Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in international development, including substantial experience in the education sector. Language Requirements: Fluency in English and Korean is required. Knewledge/Expertise/Skills: Demonstrated knowledge and technical expertise in digital education, digital learning and education-sector digital transformation, including relevant policy, programme and implementation considerations. Strong understanding of education programme design, implementation, monitoring and evidence generation, with the ability to translate analysis and evidence into practical technical recommendations. Demonstrated ability to conduct research, policy analysis, technical assessments, and synthesis of quantitative and qualitative information, and to produce high-quality technical briefs, reports, programme documents and knowledge products. Demonstrated strong knowledge of partnership development and resource mobilization, including the preparation of concept notes, technical proposals, partnership briefs, presentations and related programme materials for development, public-sector, private-sector and philanthropic partners. Ability to work effectively with government institutions, international organizations, development partners and multidisciplinary teams in a multicultural environment. Demonstrated knowledge and technical expertise in digital education, digital learning and education-sector digital transformation, including relevant policy, programme and implementation considerations. Strong understanding of education programme design, implementation, monitoring and evidence generation, with the ability to translate analysis and evidence into practical technical recommendations. Ability to work effectively with government institutions, international organizations, development partners and multidisciplinary teams in a multicultural environment. Experience supporting government-led education-sector digital transformation strategies, policies, implementation frameworks or roadmaps. Experience in the design, implementation, monitoring or evaluation of digital education initiatives in developingcountry, remote, rural or underserved contexts. Familiarity with UNICEF global or regional approaches, frameworks and tools related to digital education, education technology, connectivity, innovation or responsible use of emerging technologies. Experience working with or supporting engagement with Korean development cooperation institutions and partners, including KOICA, the Korean Committee for UNICEF (KCU), Korean public institutions, private-sector partners or philanthropic organizations. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. The purpose of this consultancy is to provide time-bound, specialized technical expertise, to support UNICEF Mongolia in advancing key priorities related to education-sector digital transformation. The assignment will focus on strengthening the strategic planning, implementation and monitoring of digital education initiatives; providing technical inputs for the development and application of innovative and inclusive digital learning approaches and solutions; and generating evidence and knowledge to inform programme planning and decision-making. The consultancy will contribute to UNICEF Mongolia’s ongoing cooperation with the Ministry of Education and other relevant partners by producing specific technical analyses, programme and policy inputs, implementation and monitoring products, knowledge products, and partnership and resource-mobilization materials. Particular attention will be given to strengthening equitable access to digital learning; supporting the effective and responsible integration of digital technologies and emerging innovations in education; and ensuring that digital education interventions respond to the needs of children in remote, rural, disadvantaged and underserved communities. The consultancy will also contribute to strengthening strategic partnerships for digital education, including engagement with Korean development cooperation partners and other international stakeholders, through the preparation of technical and programme inputs to support technical cooperation, resource mobilization, sustainability and the potential scale-up of UNICEF-supported initiatives. articles.job_description: Description de l'entreprise ALTEN DELIVERY CENTER MAROC, Filiale du leader mondial de l’ingénierie et du conseil en technologie créé en 2008 et présent à Fès, Rabat, Tétouan et Casablanca, compte aujourd’hui plus de 2300 consultants et vise un centre d’excellence de 3300 consultants ALTENiens en fin 2027. ALTEN Maroc est désormais un acteur majeur de l’insertion professionnelle des ingénieurs. Nous accompagnons nos clients, leaders de l’Industrie dans leurs stratégies de développement dans les domaines de l’automobile, du ferroviaire, de l’IT, de la R&D et des Télécoms & Médias. Rejoindre ALTEN MAROC c’est bénéficier : Des parcours professionnels diversifiés avec des opportunités de carrière, une mobilité interne, sectorielle, géographique et métiers. Des formations certifiantes et diplômantes. Des événements réguliers pour combiner bien être et performance Description du poste Responsable de la coordination des activités en phase avant-projet et développement. Il élabore et chiffre le PIV sous-système, anime les revues techniques (White Book, masse BCI), prévoit les moyens partiels, met à jour les KPI, et pilote la robustesse RFQ. En phase développement, il assure la convergence des définitions, suit le PIV physique (système, sous-système, fournisseurs), anime les routines produit/process, participe aux rituels projet, et veille à la cohérence du PIV numérique avec les KPI et le planning. Élaboration et chiffrage du PIV sous-système Support VSR : animation White Book & masse BCI Prévision des moyens partiels et besoins annexes Mise à jour des KPI performance Pilotage des séances de robustesse RFQ Pilotage de la convergence de la robustesse des définitions Préparation et pilotage de la convergence du PIV physique système/sous-système Suivi du PIV physique fournisseurs Animation GDM produit & process avant RO et process post RO Participation aux rituels projet Suivi du PIV numérique sous-système (piloté par IP) : KPI et cohérence planning Diplôme d'ingénieur ou niveau Bac+5. Entre 6 mois et 3 ans dans une fonction similaire. Bon niveau de communication en français et anglais . Informations supplémentaires

articles.seo_title: ALTEN توظف مدير مشروع (Pilot - PIV/BCI) بالرباط
articles.seo_description: تعلن شركة ALTEN عن توظيف مدير مشروع (Pilot - PIV/BCI) بالرباط. تتطلب الوظيفة دبلوم مهندس وخبرة تتراوح بين 6 أشهر و 3 سنوات في مجال مماثل.
articles.final_html:
تعلن شركة ALTEN، الرائدة عالمياً في الهندسة والاستشارات التكنولوجية، عن فتح باب الترشيح لشغل منصب مدير مشروع (Pilot - PIV/BCI) بمدينة الرباط.

هذا المنصب بدوام كامل ويستهدف المهندسين ذوي الخبرة في المجال.

مهام الوظيفة الرئيسية

  • مسؤول عن تنسيق الأنشطة خلال مرحلتي ما قبل المشروع والتطوير.
  • إعداد وتقدير تكلفة PIV للنظام الفرعي.
  • دعم VSR: تفعيل "الكتاب الأبيض" و "كتلة BCI".
  • توقع الوسائل الجزئية والاحتياجات الملحقة.
  • تحديث مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) للأداء.
  • قيادة جلسات تقوية طلب تقديم العروض (RFQ).
  • قيادة تقارب قوة التعريفات.

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596212 Contract type: Fixed Term Appointment Duty Station: Brazzaville Location: Congo Categories: Supply Management UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to a Champion. The UNICEF Congo Country Office implements the Country Programme Document (CPD) in support of the Government's efforts to advance children's rights and improve equitable access to essential social services. The programme focuses on health, nutrition, education, child protection and social policy, while supporting preparedness and response to public health emergencies, including cholera, measles, Mpox outbreaks and the risk of Ebola transmission. In support of these priorities, an effective and resilient supply chain is essential to ensure the availability of critical supplies, equipment and services across the country, particularly in challenging operational environments and during emergencies. The Supply and Logistics function contributes to programme delivery and operational efficiency by enabling timely procurement, distribution and emergency preparedness, thereby supporting UNICEF's ability to achieve results for children. You, as the Supply and Logistics Officer reports to the Deputy Representative Operations. You will play the role of country office head of the supply function, providing compliance with supply procedures and guidelines, technical and operational support to the programme, capacity building for supply staff, and is responsible for managing all aspects of supply chain management of the country office. Supply chain operations management includes planning, procurement, contracting, customs clearance, warehousing, in-country transport and distribution, and monitoring of supplies, services, construction works, and last-mile delivery. The incumbent supports collaboration with Programme and Operations sections in defining supply interventions to meet programmatic needs and achieve results for children, and provides technical and advisory support to governments, national systems and partners on supply chain management. Summary of key functions/accountabilities: Supply Chain service delivery and emergency response Collaboration with programme and implementing partners Technical, advisory support to government/national systems If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: JD Supply and Logistics Officer Final V - ws.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have… Education: A university degree is required in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Management, Economics, Contract/Commercial Law, International Development, Health or related social science field. Work Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience, at the national and international levels in public sector procurement, supply chain management, system strengthening functions, including setting-up of logistics, and/or other directly related technical fields are required. Understanding of development and humanitarian work. Strong understanding of supply chain processes, from programme needs assessment, through planning, procurement and contracting, logistics and delivery, monitoring, and evaluation. Strong knowledge of latest developments and technology in supply chain management. Strong communication and negotiation skills to establish and maintain trusted partnerships for achievement of objectives and to develop close and effective working relationships with diverse stakeholders. Strong knowledge of Supply Chain Strengthening system and experience in managing similar projects with other organizations on Supply Chain Strengthening. Skills in the identification of new opportunities or requirements to meet challenges and propose changes. Ability to identify and analyze systemic issues, formulate opinions, and make conclusions and recommendations to resolve same. Ability to clearly and concisely express ideas and concepts in written and oral form including formulation of strategies and policies. Ability to work strategically to realize organizational goals, develop strategies, set clear visions. Ability to resolve difficult, complex, and sensitive situations is often under pressure. Ability to initiate and manage change in a diverse environment. Ability to manage and monitor the effective use of financial and material resources. Ability to supervise and direct a team of professional and support staff. Ability to work in a multicultural environment and establish harmonious working relationships, both within and outside the organization. Language Requirements: Fluency in French is required. Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, English, Russian or Spanish) or a local language. Health supply chain management experiences are an advantage. Developing-country experience is an asset. Knowledge and understanding of UNICEF programmes, public and UNICEF procurement principles, financial and legal aspects of supply chain issues, ethics, and risk management of supply chain operations is a strong advantage. Relevant experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts. UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF competencies required for this post are… (1) Builds and maintains partnerships (2) Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness (3) Drive to achieve results for impact (4) Innovates and embraces change (5) Manages ambiguity and complexity (6) Thinks and acts strategically (7) Works collaboratively with others (8) Nurtures, leads and manages people Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels. UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Issuance of a visa by the host country of the duty station is required for IP positions and will be facilitated by UNICEF. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates’ willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service. As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity. UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable female candidates are encouraged to apply. Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason. UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants' bank account information. Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities. Visa residence requirements: i.e. UNICEF shall not facilitate the issuance of a visa and working authorization for candidates under consideration for positions at the national officer and general service category. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 09 Oct 2026 W. Central Africa Standard Time Deadline: 25 Oct 2026 W. Central Africa Standard Time

Ability to initiate and manage change in a diverse environment. Ability to manage and monitor the effective use of financial and material resources. Ability to supervise and direct a team of professional and support staff. Ability to work in a multicultural environment and establish harmonious working relationships, both within and outside the organization. Language Requirements: Fluency in French is required. Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, English, Russian or Spanish) or a local language. Health supply chain management experiences are an advantage. Developing-country experience is an asset. Knowledge and understanding of UNICEF programmes, public and UNICEF procurement principles, financial and legal aspects of supply chain issues, ethics, and risk management of supply chain operations is a strong advantage. Relevant experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts. UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF competencies required for this post are… (1) Builds and maintains partnerships (2) Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness (3) Drive to achieve results for impact (4) Innovates and embraces change (5) Manages ambiguity and complexity (6) Thinks and acts strategically (7) Works collaboratively with others (8) Nurtures, leads and manages people Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels. UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks.

articles.seo_description: تفتح المدرسة العليا للاساتذة في جامعة محمد الخامس مباراة توظيف لمنصب أستاذ محاضر، مع موعد إيداع 26 أكتوبر 2026 ومباراة 31 أكتوبر 2026. يفتح للمرشحين المغربيين الحاصلين على دكتوراه.
articles.final_html:
تفتح المدرسة العليا للاساتذة في جامعة محمد الخامس مباراة توظيف لمنصب أستاذ محاضر، مع موعد إيداع 26 أكتوبر 2026 ومباراة 31 أكتوبر 2026. يفتح للمرشحين المغربيين الحاصلين على دكتوراه.

عدد المناصب: 1 منصب

  • الاختبار: الثافي -

الدرجة«A»
التخصصEST A M

موعد إجراء المباراة31 أكتوبر 2026

متطلبات المشاركة

  • الجنسية: مغربية.
  • السن: يلتزم بالسن القانوني للمتسابقة.
  • الحاصل على درجة دكتوراه أو دكتوراه دولة أو معادل معترف به.
  • إرسال ملف كامل يتضمن:
    • طلب مكتوب يقدمه المرشح للمدير.
    • سيرة ذاتية مع صورة.
    • نسخة من بطاقة الهوية الوطنية الإلكترونية.
    • نسخة من شهادة الدكتوراه (لا تُقبل شهادات النجاح).
    • نسخة من الدرجات العلمية الأخرى.
    • نسخة من قرار المعادلة للمرشحين ذوي الدرجات الأجنبية.
    • نسخة من أطروحة الدكتوراه ودليل البحث العلمي.
    • تصريح من الجهة الحكومية للمرشحين العاملين أو المتجاوزين السن.
    • إقرار على الشرف معتمد.

الاختبارات

  1. اختبار على الدرجات العلمية والبحوث العلمية.
  2. اختبار شفوي: عرض ومناقشة مع لجنة الاختبار.

يُرجى التسجيل وإدخال بيانات الترشيح عبر فتح منصة الترشيح الرسمية قبل الموعد النهائي.

articles.job_description: Description de l'entreprise Chez Devoteam, nous sommes des « Digital Transformakers ». Le respect, la franchise et la passion animent chaque jour notre tribu. Ensemble, nous aidons nos clients à remporter la bataille du Digital : du conseil à la mise en œuvre de technologies innovantes, jusqu’à l’adoption des usages. Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data, DevOps, Fullstack Dev, Low Code, RPA n’ont plus aucun secret pour notre tribu ! Nos 10 000+ collaborateurs sont certifiés, formés et accompagnés au quotidien pour relever de nouveaux challenges innovants. Leader du Cloud, de la Cybersécurité et de la Data en EMEA, le Groupe Devoteam a réalisé en 2022 un chiffre d’affaires de 1,036 milliard d’euros et se donne pour ambition de le doubler dans les 5 années à venir. Devoteam Maroc, acteur de référence dans les expertises IT depuis plus de 30 ans (350+ consultants) accélère sa croissance en développant ses activités d’expertise en nearshore pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients français, européens et moyen orientaux. Description du poste Développeur(se) Full Stack Java Angular @ Creative Tech. Devoteam Creative Tech crée des produits digitaux performants qui comptent pour le business de nos clients et le quotidien des utilisateurs. Pionniers de l’UX, Devoteam Creative Tech imagine, conçoit et délivre des produits désirables et durables tout en agissant positivement sur la transformation de ses clients. Son collectif pluridisciplinaire s’appuie sur l’intelligence collective de ses talents : product managers, designers, researchers, développeurs et experts Data portés par la passion de leur métier et l’envie d’aller plus loin. Au sein des équipes Nearshore de Devoteam Maroc, tu rejoindras la tribe Product Studio : une équipe enthousiaste et experte dans le développement d’applications web et mobile. Tu seras le maillon essentiel pour : Concevoir et développer des applications à partir des exigences fonctionnelles Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des interfaces utilisateur à l'aide d'Angular Concevoir et développer des composants d'application sous forme de micro services en utilisant l'architecture Spring Boot, Java et RESTful Utiliser les outils d'intégration CI/CD (par exemple Gitlab, Jenkins, Nexus) pour gérer les versions de code, créer et stocker les artefacts et déployer les projets logiciels Développer les cas de tests unitaires pour chaque classe Java possible avec des scénarios réels utilisant Junit, Mockito, ... Tu donneras ta pleine mesure par la maîtrise de tes fondamentaux techniques, ta connaissance sur le bout des doigts des frameworks que tu utiliseras et surtout en affirmant ta volonté à comprendre les besoins et le métier du client pour lequel tu travailleras. Ton terrain de jeu : la distribution, l’énergie, la finance, l’industrie, la santé et les transports avec plein de cas d’usage et de nouveaux défis Produits à relever ensemble notamment le Développement d’applications nativement Cloud. Que tu aies foi dans le Développement Que tu sois gentil avec tes RHs Que tu t’éclates dans ta mission Et que les Codingame ne te fassent pas peur (tu ne seras pas seul : on t’aidera) Que tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du développement d’application Que tu souhaites t’investir sur les nouveaux paradigmes du développement et que tu t’engages à nos côtés dans cette aventure Que tu aimes travailler en mode agile Que tu réalises des applications de qualité, performantes et déployables automatiquement : bref le Dev(Sec)Ops fait partie de tes drivers et tu en es un promoteur convaincu Que tu sois proche des métiers, que tu les accompagnes dans la définition de leurs besoins, leurs nouveaux produits & services : dans des ateliers, en définissant les user stories et en éprouvant au travers de POC Et coder est ta passion : tu travailles ton code, tu commit en Open Source, tu fais un peu de compétition alors rejoins nous Quels atouts pour rejoindre l’équipe ? Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent A partir de 8 ans d'expérience dans la fonction Expérience avérée dans le développement de services web et d'interfaces utilisateurs sur les technologies Java, Spring Boot, Angular 19, JavaScript, TypeScript Maîtrise des outils d'intégration CI/CD et du travail en mode agile Un excellent relationnel, tu aimes travailler en équipe Un sens prononcé du service et engagé dans tes activités Savoir communiquer et écouter en toutes circonstances et écrire sans fautes … and you are fluent in english, indeed ! Poste basé au Maroc dans nos locaux de Rabat et/ou Casablanca et ouvert uniquement en CDI Poste hybride avec possibilité de télétravail En rejoignant Devoteam, vous aurez la possibilité d’échanger avec vos pairs, de partager leur expérience et de développer vos compétences en rejoignant la communauté Creative Tech rassemblant les consultants des 18 pays du Groupe Informations supplémentaires https://www.linkedin.com/company/devoteam https://www.facebook.com/devoteam

articles.final_html:
تعلن شركة Devoteam عن فتح باب التوظيف للمنصب التالي في الرباط:

خبير FullStack Java Angular Senior (H/F)

المتطلبات الأساسية:

  • درجة البكالوريوس أو الماجستير في هندسة الحاسوب أو مجال ذي صلة.
  • خبرة لا تقل عن 8 سنوات في تطوير الخدمات الويب وتطبيقات واجهة المستخدم باستخدام Java، Spring Boot، Angular، JavaScript و TypeScript.
  • إتقان أدوات التكامل المستمر (CI/CD) مثل GitLab أو Jenkins.
  • خبرة في العمل بأسلوب Agile.
  • إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية.

المسؤوليات:

  • تصميم وتطوير تطبيقات الويب والهواتف المحمولة.
  • إنشاء مكونات تطبيقية على شكل micro‑services باستخدام Spring Boot و RESTful APIs.
  • كتابة اختبارات وحدة باستخدام JUnit و Mockito.
  • إدارة الإصدارات ونشر المشاريع عبر أدوات CI/CD.
  • التعاون مع فرق متعددة التخصصات لتحديد المتطلبات وتحويلها إلى حلول تقنية.

النوع: دوام كامل (Full‑time) – عقد دائم (CDI). إمكانية العمل بنظام الهايبرد مع خيار العمل عن بُعد.

articles.job_description: خيارات الوصول المرئي تقني من الدرجة الثالثة بالمدرسة العليا للاساتذة الإدارة المنظمة جامعة محمد الخامس آخر أجل لإيداع الترشيحات 25 أكتوبر 2026 - 16:30 تاريخ إجراء المباراة 1 نونبر 2026 تاريخ النشر 9 أكتوبر 2026 معلومات عن المباراة اسم المنصب : تقني من الدرجة الثالثة بالمدرسة العليا للاساتذة نوع الإيداع : الإيداع الإلكتروني على الموقع المخصص للإدارة موقع الإيداع : https://recrutement.enssup.gov.ma/ هذا الفضاء مخصص لطرح الأسئلة والاستفسارات فقط، وليس لإيداع ملفات الترشيح. تأكيد بواسطة البريد الالكتروني تم إرسال رسالة لتأكيد تسجيل حسابك. يرجى التحقق من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني الخاصة بك
