AVISCONCOURSDE DE RECRUTEMENT
L'Ecole Normale Supérieure de Rabat organise un concours de recrutement d’un Technicien de 3°" Grade
(01 poste), session (01/11/2026) dans la spécialité suivante :
يتل اTechniciens 3ème grade : ل 0
à l'échelon national et international, rédigé obligatoirement en langue Arabe.2administratif, رج اح لح سق حر
CN ECS
du secteur concerné. minutesESet سحنConditions de participation :
Ce concours est ouvert aux candidats de nationalité marocaine, âgés entre 18 ans et 40 ans à la date du concours,
cette dernière limite d'âge pourra être prorogée d'une durée à celle égale à celle des services antérieure valables
ou validables pour la retraite sans toutefois dépasser 45 ans, titulaires d’un diplôme de Technicten spécialisé
délivré par l'une des institutions de la formation professionnelle crées conformément au décret N° 2.86.325 du
08 joumada alaoula 1407 (09 janvier 1987), portant statut général des établissements de la formation
professionnelle, ou tout diplôme reconnu équivalent conformément aux dispositions du décret N°2.12.90 du
joumada II 1433(30 Avril 2012).
Le dossier de candidature doit contenir :
٠ Une demande manuscrite de participation au concours adressé à Mr le Directeur de l’Ecole Normale
Supérieure, portant le nom, l’adresse et le numéro de téléphone du de candidat(e), signée"mianuellement,
et précisant le cadre et la spécialité ; Ÿ / سا ١
٠ Un curriculum vitae (CV) avec photo de candidat(e) ; | al / > } FA)
e Une copie de la carte nationale d’identité électronique ; Ne FR
e Une copie du diplôme requis (les attestations de réussite ne sont pas acceptées) Nese /
٠ Une copie de la décision d’équivalence du diplôme présenté, pour les candidats titulaires de diplômes
délivrés par des universités étrangères ou par un établissement d’enseignement supérieur privé ;
e Une copie légalisée du Baccalauréat ;
٠ Une autorisation de participation au concours pour les candidats fonctionnaires ;
٠ Une autorisation du Chef du Gouvernement pour les candidats ayant dépassé la limite d’âge de
recrutement ;
e Une copie du document attestant la situation de handicap, pour les candidats concernés, délivrée par les
services de l’autorité gouvernementale compétente.
٠ Déclaration sur l’honneur légalisée.
Avis important :
Les candidats souhaitant participer à ce concours sont invités à s'inscrire sur le portail électronique :
http://recrutement.enssup.gov.ma et à transmettre leurs demandes de candidature ainsi que les documents requis
via ladite plateforme électronique, et ce avant le 25/10/2026.
Les dossiers de candidature incomplets, ne remplissant pas les conditions requises, comportant des données ou
informations erronées, ou déposés hors du délai fixé ci-dessus seront formellement rejetés.
La liste des candidats admis etjustifiants les conditions réglementaires requises sera, publiée sur les sites web suivantes :
www.emploi-public.ma et https://ens.umS.ac.ma. Cette liste sera considérée comme convocation pour passer ce
concours.
La liste des candidats admis définitivement et la liste d'attente seront publiées sur le portail et sur les sites susmentionnés.
Adresse ١ Aventie Mohammed Relhasean F1 Onazzani R P : 5518 Rahat - Tél : 05 37 75 80 96 Fax ١ 05 37 75 90 63 Site weh : ens nm$ ac ma

articles.seo_title: مباراة توظيف تقني الدرجة الثالثة بالمدرسة العليا للاساتذة
articles.seo_description: مباراة توظيف تقني الدرجة الثالثة بالمدرسة العليا للاساتذة في الرباط. الموعد النهائي 25 أكتوبر 2026، الاختبار 1 نوفمبر 2026. التقديم عبر منصة الترشيح الرسمية.
articles.final_html:
مباراة توظيف تقني الدرجة الثالثة بالمدرسة العليا للاساتذة في الرباط، تُنظمها جامعة محمد الخامس. الموعد النهائي لتقديم الطلبات هو 25 أكتوبر 2026، والاختبار يُعقد في 1 نوفمبر 2026.

  • التخصص: ل 0
  • الاختبار: chttps://ens.umS.ac.maللمؤسسة

المنصب المتاح

  • تقني الدرجة الثالثة (موقف واحد).

المتطلبات الأساسية

  • الجنسية المغربية.
  • السن بين 18 و40 سنة (يمكن تمديد الحد الأقصى حتى 45 سنة).
  • حاصل على دبلوم تقني متخصص من مؤسسة معتمدة وفقًا للقرارات الوزارية.

المستندات المطلوبة

  • طلب مكتوب للانضمام إلى المنافسة (موقع إلكتروني).
  • سيرة ذاتية مع صورة.
  • نسخة من بطاقة الهوية الوطنية الإلكترونية.
  • نسخة من الدبلوم (لا تُقبل الشهادات الموقعة فقط).
  • نسخة من شهادة البكالوريا معتمد.
  • قرار equivalence إذا كان الدبلوم صادرًا من جامعة أجنبية.
  • إقرار بالشهرة موثوق.
  • إذن من مدير الخدمة إذا كنت موظفًا حكوميًا.
  • إذن من رئيس الحكومة إذا تجاوزت الحد الأقصى للسن.
  • إثبات حالة الإعاقة إذا كان ذلك مطلوبًا.

الاختبارات

المباراة تتضمن اختبارًا شفويًا واختبارًا كتابيًا باللغة العربية.

الخطوات العملية

  • التسجيل عبر فتح منصة الترشيح الرسمية.
  • رفع جميع المستندات المطلوبة قبل 25/10/2026.
  • بعد انتهاء الموعد، تُعلن قائمة المتقدمين المقبولين على emploi-public.ma و ens.umS.ac.ma.

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596218 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Colombo Level: Consultancy Location: Sri Lanka Categories: Social Policy ************************************************************************************ ************************************************************************************ UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to Protection. To support the coordination, monitoring, documentation, and institutionalization of Child Friendly Governance (CFG) across provinces and municipalities, ensuring lessons are captured and disseminated for learning, visibility, advocacy, and sustainability. This consultancy contributes to output 3 of the Social Policy Section’s biannual workplan for 2024-27 (“National and subnational government officials have enhanced capacities to use a more evidence-based and child-friendly approach to ensuring adequate and equitable investments in children”). To support the coordination, monitoring, and institutionalization of Child Friendly Governance (CFG) at the national level and across Southern and Western Provinces and selected municipalities, while documenting lessons learnt and good practices for learning, visibility, advocacy, and national ownership. The consultancy will also strengthen communications, capacity-building, and the development of a CFG Community of Practice to ensure sustainability and scale-up across Sri Lanka. • To advance national and subnational institutionalization, including capacity-building and CFG course content development. • To provide technical support for CFG implementation in Southern and Western Provinces and selected local authorities. • To consolidate technical resources, document lessons learnt and organize national learning workshops. • To support communication and outreach activities and the development of a CFG Community of Practice. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: Terms of Reference TMC0007014.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have... Social sciences, including economics, public policy, sociology, law, human rights, international development any other relevant field. • At least two years of relevant experience in governance, social policy, or child rights within Sri Lanka. • Experience working on Child Friendly Governance (CFG) or related child-friendly governance initiatives, with strong knowledge of the conceptual framework and its adaptation to Sri Lanka’s provincial and local government structures, is a very strong asset. • Experience collaborating with Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), particularly in participatory planning, budgeting, or monitoring of social sector spending, is a strong asset. • Experience engaging with media and communications platforms (including social media) to raise awareness of governance reforms, child rights, or local government initiatives is an asset. Excellent English language skills and knowledge of at least one local language is required. • Strong communication skills, including excellent professional English writing skills and presentation skills. • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills. • Solid grasp of economic, political, legal and human rights situation of Sri Lanka • Familiarity with Sri Lanka’s decentralization and local government systems, including Provincial Councils, Municipal Councils, Urban Councils, and Pradeshiya Sabhas, is highly desirable. • Understanding of current governance challenges in Sri Lanka (e.g., fiscal constraints, equity in service delivery, community participation) and ability to contextualize CFG within these realities is an asset. • Drive to achieve results for impact (1) • Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness (1) UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. UNICEF is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. Qualified candidates are invited to submit the following documents via the online recruitment portal, TMS (Talent Management System): An up-to-date TMS profile and curriculum vitae (CV) A separate financial proposal (only acceptable in the format of the linked template) Financial proposal TMC0007014.docx Remarks: If the TOR or financial proposal documents are not downloadable on certain recruitment platforms, please visit our official page Vacancies | UNICEF Careers . UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants’ bank account information. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 09 Oct 2026 Sri Lanka Standard Time Deadline: 22 Oct 2026 Sri Lanka Standard Time

articles.job_description: خيارات الوصول المرئي توظيف : إطار عال في التسيير المالي، إطار في معلوميات التسيير، تقني متخصص في النظم والشبكات الإدارة المنظمة الوكالة الحضرية للعيون آخر أجل لإيداع الترشيحات 30 أكتوبر 2026 - 16:30 تاريخ إجراء المباراة 24 نونبر 2026 تاريخ النشر 9 أكتوبر 2026 معلومات عن المباراة تخصص : - إطار عال في التسيير المالي - إطار في معلوميات التسيير - تقني متخصص في النظم والشبكات اسم المنصب : توظيف : إطار عال في التسيير المالي، إطار في معلوميات التسيير، تقني متخصص في النظم والشبكات هذا الفضاء مخصص لطرح الأسئلة والاستفسارات فقط، وليس لإيداع ملفات الترشيح. تأكيد بواسطة البريد الالكتروني تم إرسال رسالة لتأكيد تسجيل حسابك. يرجى التحقق من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني الخاصة بك
